title: %formatLocaleNumber — locale-grouped number string
purpose: Format a number using locale-specific grouping and decimal separators.
notes: Pass an explicit locale (e.g. "en-US", "de-DE") for deterministic grouping; "en-US" groups thousands with commas.
Omitting the locale uses the host system default, so always supply one for reproducible output.

avoid.why: without an explicit locale the host default locale is used, making the grouping/separator output environment-dependent
